class.name: Box2DDirectBodyState2D
class.brief_description: Direct body state provided by the Box2D physics backend.
class.description: Implements [PhysicsDirectBodyState2D] for Box2D bodies. The inherited body-state API is used by [PhysicsServer2D] and [RigidBody2D] force integration. Follow the lifetime and physics-step requirements of [PhysicsDirectBodyState2D].
